alter.title: Modify {{object}}
alter.notFound: {{name}} was not found in the database: it may have been dropped or renamed. Refresh the explorer.
alter.unsupported: This engine does not apply structure changes from DBine: write the ALTER in a query.
alter.tableNameFixed: To change the table name use “Rename…” in the explorer: it shows what depends on it before changing it.
alter.renameHint: Change the name and confirm (Enter or leave the field): DBine shows what the column is used by and the script for the change.
alter.renamedFrom: It used to be called “{{name}}”: the rename runs first.
alter.noColumnRename: This engine does not rename columns from DBine.
alter.confirmName: Confirm the new name of “{{name}}” (Enter or leave the field) to review what it affects.
alter.reviewText: Review the script: it runs in this order, and nothing is applied until you run it.
alter.noChanges: There are no changes to apply.
alter.nothingRuns: The engine can't apply these changes: the script's warnings say why. Nothing runs.
alter.rolledBack: Everything was rolled back: the table is as it was.
alter.partial: The statements before that one ({{done}}) were already applied.
alter.prodConfirm: This is a production connection. Type “{{name}}” to apply the changes.
